result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few visual issues stand out: low-contrast text in the promo banner, text truncation on the third restaurant card, and heavy placeholder-style illustrations suggesting unfinished imagery.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' text is white on a light mint-green background, making it nearly unreadable; the subtitle text is similarly low-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) for the heading and body text on the light green promo banner.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is truncated mid-word, and its card is cut off at the screen edge without an obvious affordance that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Reserve full name width or use a proper ellipsis; add a subtle peek/scroll indicator for the horizontally scrolling carousel.

issues.description: Restaurant card images use generic flat illustrations that look like placeholders rather than real food photography, giving the page an unfinished look.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder illustrations with actual restaurant photos or consistent branded imagery.

issues.description: The delivery-fee badge text on the Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria cards ('20–30 min') is white on dark translucent overlays and may have borderline contrast depending on the underlying image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure badge backgrounds are opaque enough to maintain WCAG AA contrast for all badge text.
